program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cells (find-color g
                                     (find-first (lambda (c) (!= c 0)) (grid-colors g))))
                  (r1 (min-of first cells))
                  (r2 (max-of first cells))
                  (c1 (min-of second cells))
                  (c2 (max-of second cells))
                  (bh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                  (bw (+ 1 (- c2 c1))))
             (build-grid bh (* bw 2) (r c) (at g (+ r1 r) (+ c1 (mod c bw))))))))
